title: Episode About the Slaughter of Jassu (Jassu Rai)

blocks.text: Under this renewed persecution, the Singhs survived by hiding in forests and among the reeds while Mughal forces blocking their way from all sides tried to flush them into the open. Even rivers and channels became killing grounds, with enemy fire following them into places that should have offered temporary shelter.

At night the Khalsa gathered its dead and wounded and debated whether breaking apart would save them. Yet many argued that to scatter would harm their prestige and make sovereignty impossible if the Panth abandoned the field too readily.

They therefore returned to the Guru’s prophecy of sovereignty and chose a harder course. Instead of dissolving, they resolved to steal horses from the sleeping Mughals and continue the struggle through cunning raids rather than formal battle.
